pages.text: The next one is the strangest thing in this book.

Somebody left a ring of candles around a rotten pumpkin, out in the middle of nowhere. Break the pumpkin and a rider comes out of it. Sir Pumpkinhead, people call him. Kill the horse first if you can.
$(o)Sir Pumpkinhead rides with the Witch Eye. His candle shrines turn up all over the Overworld, and they're easiest to spot at night.$()
